<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru" class="dark"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Архитектурные решения &amp; Дизайн | Isamdi.Pro</title>
  <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <!-- FontAwesome Icons -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
  <!-- Google Fonts: Inter & Outfit -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&amp;family=Outfit:wght@400;600;700;800&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      darkMode: 'class',
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            brand: {
              gold: '#D4AF37',
              bronze: '#C5A059',
              dark: '#0B0F17',
              card: '#1E293B',
              accent: '#0284C7'
            }
          },
          fontFamily: {
            sans: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],
            heading: ['Outfit', 'sans-serif'],
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>
  <style>
    body {
      background-color: #0B0F17;
      color: #F8FAFC;
    }
    .gold-gradient-text {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F6E27A 0%, #D4AF37 50%, #AA7C11 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .gold-bg-gradient {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D4AF37 0%, #B8860B 100%);
    }
    .card-glow {
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px -5px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08);
    }
    .glass-card {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }
    [contenteditable="true"]:focus {
      outline: 2px solid #D4AF37;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
      padding: 2px 4px;
    }
  </style>

<body class="min-h-screen pb-28 font-sans antialiased selection:bg-brand-gold selection:text-black">

  <!-- Admin Bar Header -->
  <div class="w-full bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-300 py-2 px-4 text-xs flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-md">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <span id="admin-status-badge" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping"></span>
      <span class="font-medium text-slate-300" id="admin-status-text">Режим редактирования активен</span>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <button onclick="resetToDefaults()" title="Сбросить к исходным данным" class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors mr-2">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i> Сброс
      </button>
      <button onclick="toggleAdminMode()" id="admin-toggle-btn" class="hover:bg-amber-500/30 border border-amber-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Сохранить</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4">

    <!-- Header / Brand Card -->
    <div class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-6 text-center relative overflow-hidden card-glow border border-amber-500/20 mb-6">
      <div class="absolute -right-10 -top-10 w-32 h-32 bg-amber-500/10 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none"></div>
      
      <!-- Logo Avatar / Image Container -->
      <div class="relative w-24 h-24 mx-auto mb-4 rounded-2xl gold-bg-gradient p-0.5 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 group">
        <div class="w-full h-full bg-slate-900 rounded-[14px] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden" id="logo-container">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-compass-drafting text-4xl text-amber-400 hidden" id="default-logo-icon"></i>
          <img id="custom-logo-img" src="data:image/png;base64," class="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="IP Isamdi.pro Logo" crossorigin="anonymous">
        </div>
        <!-- Admin Logo Upload Button -->

              <label class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Загрузить фото проекта
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" class="hidden" onchange="uploadImage(event, 10)">
              </label>
            </div>
          
            <div class="p-4">
              <div class="flex justify-between items-start gap-3 mb-2">
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">10</span>
                  <h3 class="font-bold text-white text-sm leading-snug border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50" contenteditable="true" onblur="updateItemText(10, 'title', this.innerText)">«Дизайн фасада»</h3>
                </div>
                <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-amber-400 font-heading shrink-0 border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50" contenteditable="true" onblur="updateItemText(10, 'price', this.innerText)">25 - 45 т.р.</span>
              </div>
              
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-4 ml-8 border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50" contenteditable="true" onblur="updateItemText(10, 'desc', this.innerText)">Для дома, магазина и др. (зависит от объекта)</p>

              <button onclick="orderService('«Дизайн фасада»', '25 - 45 т.р.')" class="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-950 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group">
                <span>Заказать в WhatsApp</span>
                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-emerald-400 group-hover:text-slate-950 text-sm"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div></div>

  </div>

  <!-- Bottom Floating Contact Bar -->
  <div class="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 p-3 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-800 shadow-2xl">
    <div class="max-w-md mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <a id="btn-phone-bottom" href="tel:89288785666" class="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-amber-400 rounded-xl text-center text-xs font-bold border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-phone"></i>
        <span>Позвонить</span>
      </a>
      <a id="btn-wa-bottom" href="https://wa.me/89288785666" target="_blank" class="flex-1 py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-center text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/40 transition-all" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-base"></i>
        <span>WhatsApp</span>
      </a>
      <a id="btn-tg-bottom" href="https://t.me/+89288785666" target="_blank" class="flex-1 py-3 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white rounded-xl text-center text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-sky-950/40 transition-all" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <i class="fa-brands fa-telegram text-base"></i>
        <span>Telegram</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Data Logic & Editable Storage JavaScript -->
  <script>
    // Initial Default Data (Without Arrows)
    const defaultData = {
      subheading: "Индивидуальное проектирование частных домов, проектирование коммерческих объектов, ресторанов, магазинов, офисов и прилегающей территории.",
      desc: "Проекты одноэтажных и двухэтажных домов, продуманный дизайн дворов, навесов, заборов и фасадов.",
      alertText: "<strong>Важно:</strong> Проект всего двора включает участок 4 или 6 соток.",
      phone: "8 (928) 878-56-66",
      logo: "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/chat_attachment/AF1QipNz2K-jC_v71W0y00nln50y7vI-H3hA3Jv8A2k=",
      items: [
        {
          id: 1,
          category: "one-story",
          num: "1",
          title: "«Базовый» (Без облицовки)",
          desc: "Чисто дом без двора",
          price: "40 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          category: "one-story",
          num: "2",
          title: "«Базовый + Двор» (Без облицовки)",
          desc: "Дом + навес, забор, ворота, расположение и т.д.",
          price: "50 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          category: "one-story",
          num: "3",
          title: "«Стандарт»",
          desc: "Облицовка + Подбор оттенков крыши, окон и т.д.",
          price: "55 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          category: "one-story",
          num: "4",
          title: "«Максимальный»",
          desc: "Дом с облицовкой + заборы, ворота, ландшафт и т.д.",
          price: "70 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 5,
          category: "two-story",
          num: "5",
          title: "«Базовый 2 этажа» (Без облицовки)",
          desc: "Чисто дом без двора",
          price: "60 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 6,
          category: "two-story",
          num: "6",
          title: "«Базовый 2 этажа + Двор» (Без облицовки)",
          desc: "Дом + навес, забор, ворота, расположение и т.д.",
          price: "70 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 7,
          category: "two-story",
          num: "7",
          title: "«Стандарт 2 этажа» (Без двора)",
          desc: "Облицовка + подбор оттенков, крыши, окон и т.д.",
          price: "70 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 8,
          category: "two-story",
          num: "8",
          title: "«Максимальный 2 этажа»",
          desc: "Дом с облицовкой + заборы, ворота, ландшафт и т.д.",
          price: "90 т.р.",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 9,
          category: "extra",
          num: "9",
          title: "«Ландшафтный дизайн»",
          desc: "Цена зависит от квадратуры участка",
          price: "200-300 ₽/м²",
          img: ""
        },
        {
          id: 10,
          category: "extra",
          num: "10",
          title: "«Дизайн фасада»",
          desc: "Для дома, магазина и др. (зависит от объекта)",
          price: "25 - 45 т.р.",
          img: ""
        }
      ]
    };

    let appData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('isamdi_site_data')) || defaultData;
    let isAdmin = false;

    // Save state to LocalStorage
    function saveData() {
      localStorage.setItem('isamdi_site_data', JSON.stringify(appData));
    }

    // Toggle Admin Edit Mode
    function toggleAdminMode() {
      isAdmin = !isAdmin;
      const btn = document.getElementById('admin-toggle-btn');
      const badge = document.getElementById('admin-status-badge');
      const text = document.getElementById('admin-status-text');
      const logoBtn = document.getElementById('logo-upload-btn');

      if (isAdmin) {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300');
        btn.classList.add('bg-emerald-500', 'text-slate-950');
        btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Сохранить`;
        badge.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping';
        text.innerText = 'Режим редактирования активен';
        if (logoBtn) logoBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-emerald-500', 'text-slate-950');
        btn.classList.add('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300');
        btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square"></i> Редактировать`;
        badge.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500';
        text.innerText = 'Просмотр (как видит клиент)';
        if (logoBtn) logoBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        saveData();
      }

      renderPage();
    }

    // Upload Logo Handler
    function uploadLogo(event) {
      const file = event.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(e) {
        appData.logo = e.target.result;
        saveData();
        renderPage();
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    // Reset data back to default
    function resetToDefaults() {
      if (confirm('Сбросить все изменения текста, логотипа и картинок к исходным?')) {
        appData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultData));
        saveData();
        renderPage();
      }
    }

    // Render Items Function
    function renderPage() {
      // Sync Logo Display
      const defaultIcon = document.getElementById('default-logo-icon');
      const customImg = document.getElementById('custom-logo-img');
      if (appData.logo) {
        customImg.src = appData.logo;
        customImg.classList.remove('hidden');
        defaultIcon.classList.add('hidden');
      } else {
        customImg.classList.add('hidden');
        defaultIcon.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      // Sync global editable fields
      document.querySelectorAll('.editable-field').forEach(el => {
        const key = el.getAttribute('data-key');
        if (appData[key]) {
          el.innerHTML = appData[key];
        }
        el.contentEditable = isAdmin ? "true" : "false";
        el.oninput = () => {
          appData[key] = el.innerHTML;
          saveData();
        };
      });

      updateContactLinks();

      // Clear Content Containers
      document.getElementById('content-one-story').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('content-two-story').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('content-extra').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('content-all').innerHTML = '';

      // Render items
      appData.items.forEach(item => {
        const containers = [
          document.getElementById('content-' + item.category),
          document.getElementById('content-all')
        ];

        containers.forEach(container => {
          if (!container) return;

          const card = document.createElement('div');
          card.className = "glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-slate-800 transition-all hover:border-amber-500/40 mb-4";
          
          const imgBlock = item.img ? `
            <div class="relative h-48 w-full bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden group">
              <img src="${item.img}" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" alt="${item.title}">
              ${isAdmin ? `
                <button onclick="removeImage(${item.id})" class="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-red-600/80 hover:bg-red-600 text-white w-8 h-8 rounded-full text-xs flex items-center justify-center">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
              ` : ''}
            </div>
          ` : (isAdmin ? `
            <div class="p-4 bg-slate-900/60 border-b border-slate-800 text-center">
              <label class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Загрузить фото проекта
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" class="hidden" onchange="uploadImage(event, ${item.id})">
              </label>
            </div>
          ` : '');

          card.innerHTML = `
            ${imgBlock}
            <div class="p-4">
              <div class="flex justify-between items-start gap-3 mb-2">
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">${item.num}</span>
                  <h3 class="font-bold text-white text-sm leading-snug ${isAdmin ? 'border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50' : ''}" 
                      contenteditable="${isAdmin}" 
                      onblur="updateItemText(${item.id}, 'title', this.innerText)">${item.title}</h3>
                </div>
                <span class="text-base font-extrabold text-amber-400 font-heading shrink-0 ${isAdmin ? 'border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50' : ''}" 
                      contenteditable="${isAdmin}" 
                      onblur="updateItemText(${item.id}, 'price', this.innerText)">${item.price}</span>
              </div>
              
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-4 ml-8 ${isAdmin ? 'border-b border-dashed border-amber-500/50' : ''}" 
                 contenteditable="${isAdmin}" 
                 onblur="updateItemText(${item.id}, 'desc', this.innerText)">${item.desc}</p>

              <button onclick="orderService('${item.title}', '${item.price}')" 
                      class="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-950 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group">
                <span>Заказать в WhatsApp</span>
                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-emerald-400 group-hover:text-slate-950 text-sm"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          `;

          container.appendChild(card);
        });
      });
    }

    function updateContactLinks() {
      const rawPhone = (appData.phone || '89288785666').replace(/\D/g, '');
      const cleanPhone = rawPhone.length === 10 ? '7' + rawPhone : rawPhone;

      const setHref = (id, url) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.href = url;
      };

      setHref('phone-link', `tel:${cleanPhone}`);
      setHref('btn-phone-bottom', `tel:${cleanPhone}`);
      setHref('btn-wa-top', `https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Здравствуйте! Меня интересует проект.')}`);
      setHref('btn-wa-bottom', `https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}`);
      setHref('btn-tg-top', `https://t.me/+${cleanPhone}`);
      setHref('btn-tg-bottom', `https://t.me/+${cleanPhone}`);
    }

    function uploadImage(event, itemId) {
      const file = event.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(e) {
        const item = appData.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);
        if (item) {
          item.img = e.target.result;
          saveData();
          renderPage();
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function removeImage(itemId) {
      const item = appData.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);
      if (item) {
        item.img = "";
        saveData();
        renderPage();
      }
    }

    function updateItemText(itemId, field, value) {
      const item = appData.items.find(i => i.id === itemId);
      if (item) {
        item[field] = value.trim();
        saveData();
      }
    }

    function switchTab(tabName) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950', 'shadow');
        el.classList.add('text-slate-400');
      });

      document.getElementById('content-' + tabName).classList.remove('hidden');
      const activeTab = document.getElementById('tab-' + tabName);
      if (activeTab) {
        activeTab.classList.add('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950', 'shadow');
        activeTab.classList.remove('text-slate-400');
      }
    }

    function orderService(title, price) {
      const rawPhone = (appData.phone || '89288785666').replace(/\D/g, '');
      const cleanPhone = rawPhone.length === 10 ? '7' + rawPhone : rawPhone;
      const message = `Здравствуйте! Меня интересует проект ${title} (${price}). Подскажите по срокам и составу проекта.`;
      window.open(`https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, '_blank');
    }

    // Initial Execution
    renderPage();
  </script>

</body></html>
